Tabelog not consulted: Cf-Mitigated: challenge (403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. ⚠ A 甘味処 IS THE BEST DESSERT FORMAT IN JAPAN FOR BOTH DIETS AND ALMOST NOBODY KNOWS IT. The building blocks of this menu are 寒天 (agar, set from seaweed — not gelatine), あんこ (azuki beans and sugar), 白玉 (glutinous RICE flour dumplings), 黒蜜 (brown sugar syrup) and 赤えんどう (red peas). None of those is wheat and none is animal. So 豆かん at ¥830, あんみつ at ¥830, おしるこ and ぜんざい at ¥900 are, on their standard construction, both vegan and gluten-free — in a country where a coeliac normally cannot eat dessert at all. ⚠ WHAT BREAKS IT IS DAIRY, AND IT IS ALWAYS NAMED: クリーム, アイス and 抹茶クリーム are ice cream. The one wheat item is あんこトースト, which is bread. And おでん is the outlier on a sweet menu — a dashi broth, so fish, usually with wheat-starch-bulked fish cakes in it. ⚠ ONE THING TO ASK ANYWAY: some kanmi shops add ぎゅうひ (a soft mochi) or a wheat-flour wafer to an anmitsu, and the menu does not itemise what is in each bowl. The base is safe by construction; the garnish is the question.

tokyo_shimiiru_simi_l.price_note: Full menu with prices from the shop’s own menu page — entrées, mains, desserts, courses and the drinks list. Course prices are given both excluding and including tax as the shop prints them. Tabelog not consulted: Cf-Mitigated: challenge (403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. A small French bistro built around seasonal produce and NATURAL WINE: 「当店は旬の食材を盛り込んだ料理とナチュラルワインを楽しんでいただくお店です」. No allergen statement is published. ⚠ A FRENCH BISTRO IS A BETTER PROSPECT FOR A COELIAC THAN ALMOST ANY JAPANESE FORMAT, FOR A STRUCTURAL REASON: the wheat sits in identifiable places — pastry, breadcrumb, the flour in a roux — rather than being dissolved through the seasoning the way soy sauce is in a Japanese kitchen. Here the mains are almost all ロティ, roasted, with a wine or mustard sauce; a roast is meat and heat. What has to be asked about is the SAUCE, because a French sauce is classically thickened with a beurre manié or built on a reduced stock, and neither is visible from a dish name. ⚠ TWO DISHES ARE WHEAT IN THEIR OWN NAMES: タブリエ・ド・サプール is トリッパのパン粉焼き — tripe in BREADCRUMB — and とうもろこしのフリット is a fritter, so battered. ⚠ AND FOR A VEGAN THIS IS CLOSED: every entrée and every main names a fish, a shellfish or a meat, the corn dish carries blue cheese and cream, and the bread that comes with a bistro meal is wheat. The natural-wine list is the one part a plant-eater can use, with the standing caveat that wine is routinely fined with egg white, casein or isinglass — natural wine being the style least likely to be.
